run_slurm_job: submit a Python function as a SLURM job using submitit with cluster config parameters
run_init_and_run: initialize SLURM environment variables and execute a run function with a given config
run_copy_and_run_with_config: copy the current directory and submit a job to SLURM with specified cluster configuration
review_init_and_run: review the init_and_run function that maps SLURM env vars to standard distributed training variables
review_copy_and_run_with_config: review the copy_and_run_with_config function that clones the workspace and submits a SLURM job via submitit
